title: Bone Vigil
hook: Keep the vigil in a moonlit ruin: three waves of the risen dead, one relic from the reliquary, then the bone lord.
prompt: gf-forge wave 2, the first playable (research/rust-engine/PLAN.md §4 wave 2): a dark retro first-person roguelite slice in one moonlit ruin arena. Start with a sidearm, a quick melee and an evade; three waves growing in number (grunts and skirmishers, then casters among them); a three-card reward with a full inspector; then a boss wave; win, lose and replay; live co-op for 2-4 with down and revive.

round.winBy: Hold the ruin through three waves, then break the bone lord.

props.name: chest
props.describe: the reliquary the dead come for: an iron-bound chest of relics

cards.name: Gravedigger's Scattergun
cards.text: A second weapon: two shells, eight pellets each. Key 2.

cards.name: Bellringer's Repeater
cards.text: A second weapon that fires for as long as you hold it. Key 3.

cards.name: Sexton's Hands
cards.text: Every reload is nearly a third shorter.

cards.name: Long Bandolier
cards.text: Four more rounds in the sidearm.

cards.name: Light Feet
cards.text: An evade costs less breath and is ready sooner.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.text: Your breath comes back faster, and you hold more of it.

cards.name: Bitter Draught
cards.text: Drink. Most of your health comes back, now.

cards.name: Reaper's Reach
cards.text: Your quick cut bites deeper and reaches further.

cards.name: Keen Eye
cards.text: A shot to the skull does far more.

cards.name: Heavy Rounds
cards.text: The sidearm hits harder and fires a little slower.

cards.name: Iron Heart
cards.text: Thirty more health, given at once.

cards.name: Keeper's Oath
cards.text: You raise a fallen friend in half the time, and wear more armour.

cards.name: Sawn Barrels
cards.text: The scattergun throws more shot, wider.

cards.name: Glass Saint
cards.text: Every weapon hits half as hard again. You are easier to break.

rules.summary: The dead rise from the graves of a moonlit ruin in three waves, more of them each time. Shoot, cut and dodge. After the third the reliquary opens: choose one of three relics, each changing how you fight. Then the bone lord comes. With friends, a fallen hunter can be brought back: hold E beside them. Shift evades, V is a quick cut, R reloads, 1-3 pick a weapon you have earned.
rules.scoring: each kill scores the enemy's points to whoever landed it, and each coin a point to whoever it reaches

characters.describe: you, seen in first person; friends see a hunter in your colour

content.notes: Skeletons fight and break apart; no blood.

accept: three waves rise, more of the dead each time, and the count grows with friends
after the third wave three cards are dealt and flipped, and the inspector shows exactly what the chosen one will change
the card taken changes how the player fights for the rest of the run
the bone lord comes with a few grunts; the run is won when it falls and lost when every hunter does
with friends, a fallen hunter is brought back by a friend holding E beside them
Play again starts a new run
notInV1: a shop and more than one reward
